elements.element: Vendor must maintain commercial general liability insurance.
elements.evidence: The rendered clause contains no commercial general liability insurance requirement.

elements.element: Commercial general liability insurance must have a minimum USD 1,000,000 per-occurrence limit.
elements.evidence: No commercial general liability per-occurrence limit is stated.

elements.element: Commercial general liability insurance must have a minimum USD 2,000,000 aggregate limit.
elements.evidence: No commercial general liability aggregate limit is stated.

elements.element: Vendor must maintain professional liability (errors and omissions) insurance.
elements.evidence: The clause requires Commerce One to maintain professional liability (errors and omissions) insurance.

elements.element: Professional liability (errors and omissions) insurance must have a minimum USD 2,000,000 limit.
elements.evidence: The clause requires only USD 1,000,000 of professional liability insurance.

elements.element: If Vendor processes Customer Data, Vendor must maintain cyber/privacy liability insurance.
elements.evidence: The clause unconditionally requires Commerce One to maintain cyber and privacy liability insurance, so the coverage duty applies whenever it processes Customer Data.

elements.element: If Vendor processes Customer Data, cyber/privacy liability insurance must have a minimum USD 5,000,000 limit.
elements.evidence: The clause provides only USD 2,000,000 of cyber and privacy liability insurance, not USD 5,000,000.

elements.element: Vendor must maintain workers' compensation insurance as required by law.
elements.evidence: The rendered clause contains no workers' compensation insurance requirement.

elements.element: Vendor must provide insurance certificates upon request.
elements.evidence: The rendered clause contains no obligation to provide certificates of insurance.

elements.element: Vendor must maintain professional liability (errors and omissions) insurance.
elements.evidence: The clause expressly requires Commerce One to maintain professional liability (errors and omissions) insurance.

elements.element: Professional liability (errors and omissions) insurance must have a minimum USD 1,000,000 limit.
elements.evidence: The clause specifies professional liability insurance of not less than USD 1,000,000.

elements.element: Vendor must maintain cyber/privacy liability insurance.
elements.evidence: The clause expressly requires Commerce One to maintain cyber and privacy liability insurance.

elements.element: Cyber/privacy liability insurance must have a minimum USD 2,000,000 limit.

result.reason: The operative addition exactly supplies the two fallback coverages and minimum limits, but it does not meet the preferred limits or add commercial general liability, workers' compensation, or certificates on request. The change is substantively clear, limited to insurance, and does not disturb the existing bankruptcy or integration terms. Drafting quality is reduced because the new unnumbered provision appears after the agreement's execution lead-in rather than as a properly numbered miscellaneous subsection.
